card.name: Plural S after capitalized word stems
card.fires_on: The word stem just before a plural -S in ALL-CAPS text, such as MONTH, CASE, DRUG, LEVEL, SET, CHAPTER. It is mostly in capitalized drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Caps noun before plural S
modes.description: A noun stem in all-caps label text where the next piece is the plural ending S.
modes.example: SYSTEMIC SULFONAMIDES ARE CONTRAINDICATED IN INFANTS UNDER 2<< MONTH>>S OF AGE

modes.label: Split DRUG
modes.description: The first part of DRUGS, split before the final S, in capitalized warnings.
modes.example: NITROGLYCERIN INJECTION SHOULD NOT BE MIXED WITH OTHER DR<<UG>>S.

card.writes: It promotes an uppercase plural ending (ses, SES) and suppresses lowercase s endings, so it pushes toward a capital S after the stem.
card.plain: It fires on an all-caps word that is about to get a plural S, like MONTH before S or CASE before S.
